newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 26-wk T-bill yield dips to 11.49pct(11.9pct).
newsitem.headline: Czech 26-wk T-bill yield dips to 11.49pct(11.9pct).

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank Dutch auction offering 5.0 billion crowns in 26-week finance ministry treasury bills was 11.49 percent, the CNB said on Wednesday.
In its last auction of similar bills on February 26, yield was 11.9 percent. The CNB added that Wednesday's auction was heavily oversubscried with bids totalling 13.598 billion crowns.
A total of 4.999 billion crowns in bids were accepted, the CNB said.
The six-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.12 percent on Wednesday, unchanged from Tuesday.
